Company Introduction ChuangMei Group (创美集团) is a forward-thinking fashion and lifestyle company dedicated to empowering creators and delivering curated aesthetic experiences to female consumers. This approach integrates rigorous market research, trend analysis, supplier screening, design prototyping, styling coordination, quality validation, and final production. ### Evolution The company has evolved significantly since its early days: | Year | Development | |------|-------------| | 2023 | Initial values framework established (v1) | | 2024-06-30 | 柒量一裁 (Seven Measures, One Cut) project reviewed and formalized | | 2024-07-18 | Strategic session approved updated brand positioning; slogan revision from "Everyone can be a creator" to "Everyone is born a designer" | | 2024-09-01 | Company values updated to version 2; approved by Corporate Strategy Office | | 2024 | Revenue up 12% YoY; Quality pass rate improved to 94.7%; 62% of suppliers now meet sustainability certification | ### Key Facts - **Company Name:** ChuangMei Group (创美集团) - **Primary Market:** China - **Target Demographic:** Female consumers (primarily 18-35) - **Business Model:** Multi-brand fashion & lifestyle company with online marketplace presence - **Core Philosophy:** Creator empowerment and aesthetic output **[See Section 10](#section-10) for detailed product development methodology.** --- ## 2. Our products and brand positioning are curated to deliver high-quality aesthetic experiences that resonate with our female consumer base. 2. **Strictly Select Suppliers (严选供应商):** We maintain rigorous standards across our entire supply chain. This involves comprehensive supplier screening, quality certification verification, and continuous performance monitoring. Suppliers must align with our aesthetic requirements, ethical standards, and sustainability commitments. 3. **Create Customer Value (创造客户价值):** We deliver products and experiences that genuinely enrich our customers' lives, particularly addressing **non-standard customer needs** through empowered creators. ### Implementation - Every phase of our **柒量一裁 (Seven Measures, One Cut)** methodology directly serves the three pillars of our mission. - Team members are trained and evaluated based on how well they contribute to these three objectives. - Customer satisfaction and retention are measured against our mission outcomes. **[See Section 10](#section-10) for how our product development methodology operationalizes this mission.** --- ## 3. Vision **Vision (愿景):** - **Version 1 (2023):** Build the largest online fashion marketplace for female consumers (打造全国最大的女性时尚线上市场) - **Version 2 (2024, Current):** Build a mutually inspiring creator paradise (打造一个相互激发的创作者乐园); Shape a group of brands beloved by female consumers (塑造一批深受女性消费者喜爱的品牌) ### Dual-Dimension Vision Our vision operates on two interconnected dimensions: #### Internal Dimension: Creator Paradise Internally, we aspire to build an environment where **creators inspire one another** — a true paradise of mutual creative stimulation. This means: - Every team member, regardless of department, is recognized as a creator - Knowledge and creative ideas flow freely across departmental silos - Cross-functional collaboration is normalized and encouraged - Recognition and reward systems celebrate creator contributions and cross-functional wins #### External Dimension: Beloved Brands Externally, we aim to cultivate a portfolio of brands that **female consumers genuinely love and trust**. This means: - Consistent aesthetic quality across all brands - Strong brand positioning that resonates with target demographics - Ongoing customer feedback and iteration - Transparent communication about product development and sourcing ### Historical Evolution The evolution of our vision reflects our strategic growth objectives and digital transformation roadmap: | Version | Date | Focus | |---------|------|-------| | v1 | 2023-03-15 | Scale: Largest online fashion marketplace for female consumers | | v2 | 2024-09-01 | **Creator-centric:** Build a creator paradise AND beloved female-consumer brands | **[See Section 4](#section-4) and [Section 5](#section-5) for related company values and slogan alignment with our current vision.** --- ## 4. Values Our values are organized into **three progressive tiers**, each building on the previous one: ### Tier 1 — Mindset (心态层) **Current Version (v2):** 合作、创新、协同、赋能 **Cooperation, Innovation, Synergy, Empowerment** These four pillars define how we think about relationships — with colleagues, partners, suppliers, and customers. We believe in collaborative success where all parties benefit. | Value | Description | |-------|-------------| | **Cooperation (合作)** | Working together toward common goals; recognizing interdependence | | **Innovation (创新)** | Continuous improvement and creative problem-solving; not settling for "good enough" | | **Synergy (协同)** | Creating value that exceeds the sum of individual contributions; cross-functional alignment | | **Empowerment (赋能)** | Enabling others to succeed and contribute their best; distributing power and autonomy | **[See Section 8](#section-8) for how these mindset values inform our team collaboration philosophy.** ### Tier 2 — Execution Standards (执行标准) **一经确认未变:** 一听就懂、一看就会、边抄边改、用户导向 **Easy to understand, Easy to follow, Copy-and-adapt, User-oriented** Our execution philosophy prioritizes clarity and pragmatism: 1. **Easy to Understand (一听就懂):** Instructions and communications should be immediately comprehensible. Starting with someone else's proven approach and adapting it to our context is a strength, not a weakness. Most fashion designs are derivative in origin; what matters is how we combine and present them. 4. **User-Oriented (用户导向):** Everything we do must be oriented toward the end customer's needs and preferences. ### Tier 3 — Self-Transcendence (自我超越) **一成不变:** 好奇心是最好的老师 **Curiosity is the best teacher.** Beyond mindset and execution, we believe in continuous growth driven by genuine curiosity: - The desire to explore, question, and discover is what separates good from great - Stay open to new ideas, trends, and perspectives - Treat every failure as a learning opportunity ### Version Evolution | Tier | Version 1 (2023) | Version 2 (2024, Current) | Rationale | |------|-----------------|-------------------------|-----------| | Tier 1 | 合作、**共赢**、协同、赋能 | 合作、**创新**、协同、赋能 | Shifted from "Win-win" to "Innovation" to reflect our evolving emphasis on continuous improvement and creative problem-solving | | Tier 2 | 一听就懂、一看就会、**重用竞品、用户导向** | 一听就懂、一看就会、**边抄边改、用户导向** | Changed "Using competitor products" to "Copy-and-Adapt" to be more precise and reduce defensive associations | | Tier 3 | 好奇心是最好的老师 | 好奇心是最好的老师 | Unchanged | **[See Appendix: Source Index](#appendix-source-index) for detailed source file attributions and conflict resolutions.** --- ## 5. This aligns with our creator-first philosophy and supports our vision of building a creator paradise. - **Action-Oriented:** While "everyone can be a creator" was aspirational, "everyone IS born a designer" is more declarative and empowers team members to act from their natural creative instincts. ### Implementation The slogan guides our internal culture and external messaging: - **Internal:** Every employee should feel empowered to share creative ideas, experiment with their work, and recognize their unique creative contributions. - **External:** Our marketing and brand communications emphasize creativity as something natural and accessible, not reserved for "special" designers. **[See Section 6](#section-6) for how this connects to our creator philosophy.** --- ## 6. Creator Philosophy ### Core Definition At ChuangMei Group, we define the **Creator Spirit (创作者精神)** as the combination of two essential powers: > **Creator Spirit (创作者精神) = Emotional Power (情绪力) + Styling Power (搭配力)** ### Emotional Power (情绪力) **Definition:** The ability to perceive, channel, and express emotions through aesthetic choices. A creator with strong emotional power understands how visual elements — color, texture, form — evoke specific feelings and can harness this understanding to create resonant experiences. **Why It Matters:** Fashion is inherently emotional. People don't just buy clothes — they buy feelings, moods, and identities. Emotional power is what distinguishes our stylists from average retailers: | Aspect | Description | |--------|-------------| | **Perception** | Sensing what emotions a customer is trying to express (through verbal cues, body language, style preferences) | | **Channeling** | Understanding which colors, cuts, and materials evoke the desired emotional response | | **Expression** | Presenting combinations that make customers FEEL something specific | ### Styling Power (搭配力) **Definition:** The ability to coordinate, combine, and curate individual elements into a cohesive and expressive whole. Styling power transforms raw materials and designs into meaningful aesthetic statements. **Why It Matters:** Styling power is where true creativity lives in our industry. It's the difference between selling individual items and creating curated experiences. | Aspect | Description | |--------|-------------| | **Understanding** | Knowing how pieces work together (colors, styles, occasions, seasons) | | **Coordination** | Combining disparate elements into intentional, harmonious outfits | | **Curating** | Building collections that tell a story and have a clear aesthetic direction | ### The Copying Paradox We acknowledge a fundamental truth that often causes confusion: > **Most styles and designs are copied (大部分款式都是抄的). This is not a criticism — it is a reality of the fashion industry.** But here's the key insight: > **Styling and coordination (搭配) IS creation.** The fashion industry inherently builds upon existing designs and patterns. Systems Thinking & Closed-Loop Iteration ### What is Systems Thinking? Systems thinking is the practice of viewing challenges and opportunities as **interconnected parts of a larger whole**, rather than isolated events. At ChuangMei Group, we apply systems thinking to everything from product development to team management to customer experience. ### The Closed-Loop Iteration Cycle Our methodology follows a **cyclical approach with five key stages**: ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ Observe → Hypothesize → Test → Measure → │ │ ↖ ↙ │ │ ↑ ↓ │ │ └─────────────┴────────────────┘ │ │ Iterate │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ╱ ← ╲ / \ (Data flows continuously) (Learning compounds) ``` #### 1. Observe (观察) Gather comprehensive data from: - Market trends - Customer feedback (surveys, interactions, returns) - Internal operations - Competitor activities - Team insights and hypotheses **Question:** What is happening? What trends are emerging? What pain points exist? #### 2. Hypothesize (假设) Based on observations, form **clear, testable hypotheses**: - "If we introduce this styling combination, we expect a 15% increase in customer engagement." - "If we adjust our sizing to this spec, return rates will decrease by 5%." - "If we partner with supplier X, lead times will improve by 30%." **Principle:** Be specific, be measurable, be falsifiable. #### 3. Test (测试) Design and execute **controlled tests**: - Launch pilot products with a limited audience - A/B test different marketing approaches - Trial new supplier partnerships - Run small-scale production runs **Principle:** Test one variable at a time when possible. Keep scope manageable. #### 4. Measure (衡量) Collect **quantitative and qualitative data** on test outcomes: - Sales data, conversion rates, ROI - Customer satisfaction scores - Return rates - Team collaboration effectiveness Use defined **KPIs** to assess performance objectively. **Principle:** Measure what matters, measure consistently, document everything. #### 5. Iterate (迭代) Based on measurements, **refine and refine**: - What worked? Scale it up. - What didn't? Learn from it. - What surprised us? Investigate further. - Feed learnings back into observation for the next cycle. **Principle:** Every cycle should generate learnings that compound. ### Closed-Loop Principle **Closed-loop means every initiative must have measurable outcomes that feed back into the next cycle.** There are no "open-ended" projects without accountability. Every action generates data, every data point informs the next action. This creates a virtuous cycle of continuous improvement. **Open-Ended = No Closure = No Learning = No Improvement** ### How It Works in Practice The closed-loop iteration cycle is embedded in all major business processes: | Process | Loop Integration | |---------|------------------| | **Product Development** | 柒量一裁 (Seven Measures, One Cut) methodology (see Section 10) | | **Supply Chain** | Regular supplier audits → Performance data → Process improvements | | **Marketing** | Campaign metrics → Creative insights → Next campaign direction | | **Customer Service** | Support tickets → Trend analysis → Training updates | | **Team Development** | Performance reviews → Growth plans → New training programs | --- ## 10. Seven Measures One Cut Project ### Overview **柒量一裁 (Seven Measures, One Cut)** is our systematic product development methodology. The name is a metaphor drawn from traditional craftsmanship: **measure seven times before making a single decisive cut**. It represents our commitment to rigorous analysis and preparation before execution. This methodology integrates our core values (**输出审美，严选供应商，创造客户价值**) into a structured, repeatable, and data-driven process. ### The 7 Phases #### Phase 1: Market Research (市场调研) Comprehensive analysis of market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive landscape, with focus on female consumer preferences and emerging aesthetic movements. **Key Activities:** - Consumer surveys and focus groups - Social media trend monitoring (Little Red Book, Instagram, Pinterest) - Competitor product analysis (pricing, styles, materials) - Seasonal demand forecasting **Output:** Market insight report and opportunity identification. #### Phase 2: Trend Analysis (趋势分析) Deep dive into fashion and lifestyle trends, identifying patterns that align with ChuangMei Group's aesthetic philosophy and target audience preferences. **Key Activities:** - Global fashion week analysis - Color and material trend forecasting (Pantone, WGSN) - Cultural and social trend mapping - **Creator community input gathering** — leveraging our "everybody is a creator" philosophy to tap into grassroots style insights **Output:** Trend report and trend-based product concepts. #### Phase 3: Supplier Screening (供应商筛选) Rigorous evaluation and selection of suppliers based on quality, reliability, ethical standards, and alignment with aesthetic requirements. This embodies our mission pillar of **严选供应商 (strictly select suppliers)**. **Key Activities:** - Supplier capability assessment - Quality certification verification - Sample evaluation and testing - Ethical and sustainability audit **Output:** Approved supplier list with performance scores and aesthetic alignment ratings. #### Phase 4: Design Prototyping (设计打样) Creation of initial design concepts and physical prototypes, incorporating insights from market research, trend analysis, and customer feedback. **Key Activities:** - Concept sketching and digital design - Material selection and sourcing - Prototype production - Internal design review (cross-functional) **Output:** Finalized design and approved prototype specifications. #### Phase 5: Styling Coordination (搭配协调) **The creative heart of the process** — where individual pieces are combined into coordinated looks and collections. This phase embodies the **creator spirit** and **styling power (搭配力)**. **Key Activities:** - Look coordination and styling sessions - Cross-category pairing experiments - **Creator-led styling workshops** — our most valuable internal mechanism - Photography and visual presentation planning **Note:** This is where "copying" becomes "creating" — by combining existing pieces in new, meaningful ways, our stylists generate unique value. #### Phase 6: Quality Validation (品质验证) Comprehensive quality testing of final prototypes, including wear testing, material durability assessment, and customer feedback collection. **Key Activities:** - Wear testing with focus groups - Material stress and durability testing - Fit and comfort evaluation - **Customer feedback integration** before scale-up **Output:** Quality validation report with go/no-go recommendation. #### Phase 7: Final Production (最终生产) Full-scale production launch based on validated designs, with ongoing quality monitoring and closed-loop feedback mechanisms. **Key Activities:** - Production order placement - In-line quality inspection - Packaging and presentation finalization - Launch readiness review - Post-launch monitoring for next iteration cycle **Output:** Launched products and customer data for next observation phase. ### Core Principles The 柒量一裁 methodology is grounded in our core principles: | Principle | Description | |----------|-------------| | **Data-Driven Decision Making** | Every decision is informed by data, not gut feeling | | **Aesthetic Output as Primary KPI** | Quality, beauty, and coherence of the final output matter more than speed | | **Supplier Excellence Through Strict Selection** | We invest time upfront to build relationships with high-quality suppliers | | **Creator Empowerment at Every Phase** | Creators are engaged and utilized throughout, not just in design | ### Connection to Company Values The 柒量一裁 methodology operationalizes our company values: | Value | How 柒量一裁 Embodies It | |-------|------------------------| | **Output Aesthetics (输出审美)** | Every phase prioritizes aesthetic quality and coherence | | **Strictly Select Suppliers (严选供应商)** | Phase 3 is dedicated to rigorous supplier evaluation | | **Create Customer Value (创造客户价值)** | The entire process is designed to deliver personalized value | ### Connection to Non-Standard Customer Value Our methodology is explicitly designed to serve **non-standard customers**: - **Phase 1 & 2:** Understanding unique customer preferences and needs - **Phase 4 & 5:** Enabling creative combinations and personalization - **Phase 6:** Validating that the solution actually works for the customer -
